fixed_goal.display1: A distinct simultaneous authentic iPhone CarPlay Type111 navigation stream in the existing instrument-cluster Navigation region.

components.implementation: Custom receiver models primary-session ownership and stock-first preservation; a separate mock stock-owner adapter exercises generation-bound Type111 delegation and secondary-only failure/teardown. No proof it can coexist with Honda's authenticated receiver.

components.remaining_code: Keep all ClarityLink ownership confined to its own lab receiver; replace no mock with a production Honda interface without separate evidence and authorization.

components.compatibility_concerns: The mock adapter is not a Honda interface or coexistence proof.

components.implementation: Evidence-labeled Type111 hypothetical setup contract runs behind a mock stock-primary session; stale generations, duplicate identities, serializer/listener failure and child-only teardown preserve the primary response/owner.
components.interfaces: Type111 setup request/response model, stock-first mock delegation, generation-scoped secondary state, and capability-plan ownership

components.missing_external_capability: Honda's Type111 request behavior, accepted response schema and iPhone admission are unknown.

components.implementation: Receiver performs independent stream I/O outside the shared state lock, validates resource identities before display commit, and listener accept is serialized to preserve the one-client ownership limit.
components.interfaces: Listener and per-session transport adapters
components.remaining_code: Unify per-stream endpoints, cancellation, generation checks and independent teardown.

components.compatibility_concerns: Host socket tests do not establish target reachability or port behavior.

components.implementation: Provider abstractions and explicit host/replay/LIVI/hardware authority boundaries exist; provider support does not imply Honda Type111 keys or authorization. Contexts enforce unsigned 64-bit generation/stream identities, bounded 8 MiB protected frames, byte-only fixture AEAD inputs, one-shot key lifecycle, and reject primary/secondary provider-object aliasing. The generated-key ChaCha provider remains an offline fixture; production Type111 security fails closed.
components.interfaces: AuthenticationProvider, session handoff, screen crypto contract
components.remaining_code: Distinct authorized per-stream production key derivation and genuine Type111 cryptographic/session evidence remain unimplemented; unknown production crypto stays fail closed.
components.missing_external_capability: Permitted Honda-session delegation and Type111 security algorithm/key material are unproven.
components.security_concerns: Never extract secrets, bypass MFi, or infer Type111 keys from Type110/prior art.
components.compatibility_concerns: Offline provider conformance is not a real authenticated session.

components.remaining_code: Prove supported format combinations against compatible fixtures and keep evidence labels attached.

components.compatibility_concerns: Type110 and synthetic fixtures do not imply Type111 equivalence.

components.implementation: Host fixture decoder and AVCC/H.264 configuration helpers remain; an API16+ MediaCodec Surface adapter now bounds dimensions and access units, extracts bounded Annex-B SPS/PPS, fences generations/timestamps, supports explicit codec reset, and borrows (never releases) display-owned Surfaces. A two-stream synthetic lab uses distinct decoder instances. CL-IMP-11 runs two distinct H.264 fixture streams through independent receiver paths; Type111 decoded PNG frames are converted to bounded RGBA and rendered through the existing renderer.
components.interfaces: Api17SurfaceH264Decoder accepts clear Annex-B access units and generation/timestamp metadata and submits decoded output to a borrowed Surface.
components.remaining_code: Integrate complete production H.264 access-unit parsing/packetization, authenticated Type111 input, stream-config normalization, asynchronous buffering and renderer lifecycle; no ARMv7 JNI decoder bridge is claimed.
components.missing_external_capability: No authentic iPhone Type111 H.264 stream fixture, production stream security context, or target decoder result.
components.security_concerns: Codec input is untrusted; bounds are enforced for dimensions, access units and synchronous in-flight input; production framing and resource-pressure soak remain for later milestones.
components.compatibility_concerns: API17 x86 emulator validated synthetic decoder-to-Surface submission and reset. Codec output may report macroblock-padded dimensions; production crop/viewport handling is deferred to CL-IMP-09. Surface submission is not physical scanout evidence.

components.implementation: JNI/native Surface sink and lifecycle primitives are built for ARMv7/API17. CL-IMP-12 produces a separate libclaritylink_android.so artifact and API17 symbol audit; the native library is not loaded by the Java lab APK.
components.interfaces: NativeBridge handles, Surface sink, generation lifecycle
components.remaining_code: Integrate and validate decoder output through the JNI bridge and Android renderer in a reproducible test package; no Honda process bridge or production target path exists.
components.missing_external_capability: No approved bridge into Honda's display process.
components.security_concerns: Opaque handles, stale-generation rejection, JNI exception and buffer lifetime safety.
components.compatibility_concerns: Existing builds target lab/test code and do not certify Honda integration.

components.implementation: API17 Java CPU RGBA frame snapshots and bounded hosted View renderer provide latest-frame replacement, generation/timestamp fencing, crop, quarter-turn rotation, aspect fit, synthetic safe-area/protected-region clipping, warning clearing and deterministic lifecycle cleanup. Safe bounds round inward and protected bounds outward at fractional scales. Geometry is immutable and synthetic-only.
components.interfaces: Display1OutputBackend.Host, Viewport, DecodedFrame, RendererViewport
components.remaining_code: Connect authenticated Type111 decoder output only after external interfaces are established; Honda viewport and host admission remain unproven.
components.missing_external_capability: No Honda renderer host admission, physical scanout, or measured safe viewport.
components.security_concerns: Stale frames and retained bitmaps must be cleared on every failure path; protect safety-critical rectangles from navigation content.
components.compatibility_concerns: Canvas/CPU path and emulator admission may not match Honda Tegra/display behavior; synthetic geometry is not physical cluster geometry.

components.implementation: API17 Presentation candidate is now used by a standalone app adapter with status-only startup, explicit emulator confirmation, unique 800x480 display selection, hosted renderer attachment, no declared permissions, lifecycle teardown and no automatic re-admission after process death. A separately signed candidate APK has disabled application/activity components.
components.interfaces: SecondaryDisplayHost, DisplayPolicy, Presentation Surface callbacks
components.remaining_code: Keep the candidate disabled; prove any later supported production permission and admission interfaces independently before wiring them.
components.missing_external_capability: Honda cluster display admission by an independent application remains unknown.

components.compatibility_concerns: Presentation success on emulator does not establish Honda Display 1 availability.

components.implementation: The ClarityLink-owned simulator and independent API17 application both host the reusable content View through public FrameLayout/Presentation APIs. The app is a lab adapter with emulator-only admission and a disabled candidate artifact; it does not acquire a Honda root.
components.interfaces: Candidate host/root and viewport interface only
components.remaining_code: Keep the simulator/app adapters separate from production and preserve the disabled production integration boundary.
components.missing_external_capability: No public Honda root-acquisition or supported frame-submission interface; HondaHack uses in-process integration.
components.security_concerns: Do not install hooks, inject into stock processes or claim safe ownership.
components.compatibility_concerns: HondaHack path is prior art; its private classes/layout are not a supported ClarityLink API.

components.implementation: A private API17 Binder protocol streams owned decoded RGBA bytes through a ParcelFileDescriptor pipe to a separate project-owned compositor process. Payloads are limited to 4 MiB, one frame may be in flight, session generations and timestamps are fenced, and the simulated compositor retains bounded metadata rather than frame bytes. This is pipe IPC, not shared-memory IPC.
components.interfaces: Versioned private Binder BEGIN/FRAME/WARNING/END transactions; generation-tagged DecodedFrame; one-slot FrameBackpressureGate
components.remaining_code: Connect the simulated IPC compositor to the future Type111 receiver and real decoder output while preserving independent primary ownership; shared-memory optimization is not implemented.
components.missing_external_capability: Honda host process does not expose a public IPC endpoint or supported display compositor API.
components.security_concerns: The lab-only non-exported service checks caller UID and protocol version, validates frame metadata and exact payload length, caps bytes at 4 MiB, enforces single-flight backpressure, and clears state at warning/session/process teardown.
components.compatibility_concerns: Pipe IPC and compositor behavior were tested on an isolated API17 emulator; no Honda IPC, Honda compositor, physical scanout, or production permission policy is proven.

components.implementation: DualDisplayRuntime maintains independent Type110/Type111 workers with generation-scoped cleanup. CL-IMP-11 composes this runtime with bounded synthetic fixture producers, mock stock-first delegation, and generation-2 reconnection. Host-only; no Honda process lifecycle claim.

components.security_concerns: Generation fencing and deterministic child cleanup.
components.compatibility_concerns: Model lifecycle is not Honda process lifecycle evidence.

components.implementation: Warning visibility is generation-fenced through the private lab Binder protocol and simulated compositor model; the model clears retained-frame accounting and rejects frames while warning is visible. No host/event integration blanks the Presentation or a physical display. CL-IMP-11 host demo exercises synthetic warning preemption, dropped Type111 frames, and resume; this does not establish Honda warning events or policy.

components.security_concerns: Secondary navigation must yield to safety UI and clear stale content.
components.compatibility_concerns: Model behavior cannot establish Honda warning arbitration or physical blanking.

components.implementation: Runtime closes its project-owned ReceiverSession and boundedly joins workers; Receiver cleanup is conditional on captured resource identity to prevent stale workers closing replacements. Listener has one serialized accepted endpoint. CL-IMP-11 verifies generation-scoped worker stop, runtime close, mock delegation revocation, and zero receiver resources at final close.
